bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (runtime, dispatch, run, parameter enums, property paths), springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs (headless window test kit), springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs (Spotlight index), springboard/src/shell/intents.rs (shell side)
summary: BifrOSt has an App Intents runtime served over the control socket (intent.list, intent.<id>, entity.query), an in-process run() that returns a typed IntentResult, enum parameters, and string property paths into results, plus a headless UI test kit. Still missing: value query results, entity annotation, transient entities and typed key paths, so tests compare JSON values by path rather than typed fields.

features.feature: Running an intent out-of-process in tests
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (pub fn run, line 351; pub fn dispatch; unit test run_performs_by_id_and_checks_parameters_first)
features.note: run() performs an intent by id in-process and returns the typed IntentResult after parameter checks; the app still runs in-process, not out-of-process, and there is no separate test session object
The catalog is served as intent.list JSON; there is no typed definition collection for tests

features.feature: Entity queries (suggested, by id, by string)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (EntityQuery enum, parse_entity_query, entity.query in dispatch)
features.note: Query variants Suggested, Ids and String exist; no AnyEntityQuery wrapper
Results are {value, dialog}; from_json reads a control-socket reply back into the typed struct and at(path) reads a nested field, but the path is a string checked at run time, not a type
No intent value query concept; entity.query returns a flat list of {id, title, subtitle, type}
No API to annotate a view with an entity; the accessibility tree (bifrost_ui::ax, springboard/ui/src/ax.rs) carries labels but no entity link

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (untyped Json values; Entity struct; run() takes the intent id)
features.note: Everything is Json already; intents are addressed by id string. No named wrapper types and no exported(as:) equivalent
Enum parameters are declared with their case names and reject any other text. No enum type identifier, no typed raw value, and no transient entities

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (PropertyPath, PathStep, PropertyPath::parse, PropertyPath::resolve; unit test property_path_resolves_into_nested_results)
features.note: Paths like items[2].title read nested result values by name and index. Paths are parsed from strings, so there is no compile-time check, no path-to-type cast, and no callable that builds intents from keyword arguments
Search lists intents with shortcut = true and no required parameter; no Siri, no dialog display, and no test hook to check what Search shows

features.feature: Headless test harness for app UI
features.apple: Test target harness (used by App Intents Testing for in-app checks)
features.note: Clicks, keys and accessibility queries work headless; nothing in it knows about intents or entities

gaps: No test session object: run() is a free function that runs the intent in the same process, with no separate runner or out-of-process execution.
No value query results or intent value queries (ResolvedValueQueryResult, IntentValueQueryDefinition).
No entity annotation or onscreen context (ViewAnnotation), so Search and voice assistants cannot be told what is on screen.
No transient entities (AnyTransientAppEntity) and no enum type identifiers with typed raw values (AnyAppEnum).
Property paths are string-parsed and checked at run time only; there is no typed key path and no keyword-argument intent builder (IntentValuePropertiesCallable).
Siri and voice dialog verification is not modelled (see docs/bifrost-ui.md App Intents gaps).
